create_LCMScheduler: create an LCMScheduler instance with custom beta schedule and timestep scaling parameters
set_timesteps_LCMScheduler: set the discrete inference timesteps for the LCM scheduler before running denoising
step_LCMScheduler: perform one denoising step by predicting the previous sample from model output and current timestep
add_noise_LCMScheduler: add Gaussian noise to original samples according to the scheduler noise schedule at given timesteps
betas_for_alpha_bar: create a beta schedule tensor using cosine, exponential, or laplace alpha bar transforms
